teaser.en: It grows so thick that animals get trapped in it, and its stiff hairs make humans itch too.
teaser.sw: Hukua kwa wingi kiasi kwamba wanyama hunaswa ndani yake, na nywele zake ngumu huwawasha binadamu pia.

summary.en: *Mwambanyama* is itch grass, a coarse, tall grass of fallow and disturbed ground with irritating stiff hairs. Its Digo name, 'animal trapper', describes how densely it grows.
summary.sw: *Mwambanyama* ni *itch grass*, nyasi ndefu na ngumu ya mashamba yaliyoachwa na ardhi iliyovurugwa, yenye nywele ngumu zinazowasha. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'mtega wanyama', linaeleza jinsi inavyoota kwa wingi.

about.en:
*Mwambanyama* is a tall, coarse grass with broad leaves. Its leaf sheaths are covered in stiff, sharp hairs that break off and irritate the skin, which gives it the English name 'itch grass'.

The flowering heads are thin, cylindrical spikes that break apart into segments when ripe.
about.sw:
*Mwambanyama* ni nyasi ndefu na ngumu yenye majani mapana. Ala za majani yake zimefunikwa kwa nywele ngumu na kali zinazokatika na kuwasha ngozi, na ndiko jina la Kiingereza *itch grass* linakotoka.

Vishada vya maua ni mashada membamba ya mviringo yanayovunjika kuwa pingili yakiiva.

where.en: Look for *mwambanyama* on fallow land and disturbed ground, including the edges of farms. It can form dense, almost impassable stands.
where.sw: Itafute *mwambanyama* kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa na ardhi iliyovurugwa, ikiwemo kando ya mashamba. Inaweza kufanya vichaka vizito visivyopitika kwa urahisi.

uses.en:
The Digo boil the leaves as a remedy for malaria.

On farms it is a troublesome weed, competing hard with crops such as maize.
uses.sw:
Wadigo huchemsha majani yake kama dawa ya malaria.

Mashambani ni gugu sumbufu, linaloshindana vikali na mazao kama mahindi.

culture.en: *Mwambanyama* means 'animal trapper'. It grows so densely that animals passing through can become trapped in it.
culture.sw: *Mwambanyama* linamaanisha 'mtega wanyama'. Huota kwa wingi kiasi kwamba wanyama wanaopita ndani yake wanaweza kunaswa.

names.en: Digo: *mwambanyama*, 'animal trapper'. English: itch grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Rottboellia exaltata* (also known as *R. cochinchinensis*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mwambanyama*, 'mtega wanyama'. Kwa Kiingereza: *itch grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Rottboellia exaltata* (pia hujulikana kama *R. cochinchinensis*).

reason.en: Tall grass of the same fallow land
reason.sw: Nyasi ndefu ya mashamba yale yale yaliyoachwa
Nyasi nyingine ndefu ya mashamba yaliyoachwa
Dawa nyingine ya Kidigo ya malaria

reason.en: Another irritating weed of disturbed ground
reason.sw: Gugu jingine la ardhi iliyovurugwa linalowasha

taxon.note: Pakia's Rottboellia exaltata is a synonym of R. cochinchinensis
